summary: You mix reference images into `contents` alongside the text prompt; there is no separate reference-image field. The count and the roles those images can play differ by model.
combines: `gemini-3-pro-image`: up to 14 images total, of which up to 6 are high-fidelity object references, up to 5 are character-consistency references, and up to 3 are style references. The Limitations section words the object budget as "5 images with high fidelity, and up to 14 images in total", so treat 5 to 6 as the practical high-fidelity ceiling.
`gemini-3.1-flash-image`: up to 14 total, up to 10 high-fidelity object references, up to 4 character references, no style-reference slot.
`gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`: up to 14 object references, no character or style reference support; the docs say it is not optimized for multiple reference inputs or multi-turn sequential editing.
`gemini-2.5-flash-image`: works best with up to 3 input images.
Audio input is never supported for image generation. Video input is supported only on `gemini-3.1-flash-image`.

Per-request size limits are the general Gemini limits, not image-specific: inline request payloads are capped at 20MB, and larger files go through the File API. The image-generation page itself does not state a byte limit.
Input token limits bound how much you can attach: 65,536 on `gemini-3-pro-image`, 131,072 on `gemini-3.1-flash-image`. Output token limit is 32,768 on both.
range: up to 14 reference images on Gemini 3 image models
